Source-only request ecf80308-fa67-4ecd-a3d1-aad877e3a81d completed as source handoff, NOT runtime acceptance. Published origin/codex/native-sheet-contract-probe at5ebeb17a, one diagnostic commit above93244f8f. Adapter product/tests unchanged (git diff exit0); all three added files are tools/coordination/native-sheet-contract-probe/{NativeSheetContractProbe.swift,run_probe.py,README.md}. git diff --check passed. NO compile/run/test/app/benchmark on B; heartbeat/writer untouched.

Standalone tiny AppKit windows, no Tessera dependency: queued-cancel validates actual sentinel attachment and owned queued parent.sheets membership before ending ONLY captured owned sheet; parent-close raw, end-then-parent-close, and close-handler-end distinguish automatic close semantics from the adapter-style explicit end in willClose. Each can run raw or --order-out-in-completion (actual owned orderOut logged, matching adapter; raw failures kept separate). JSONL records invocation UUID, physical parent/owned/unrelated identities, sequence, native completion/notifications, exact attached+sheets membership, sentinel unchanged, completion counts and cleanup retirement. Parent-only notification never fabricates owned completion.

5s diagnostic watchdog fails without inventing native completion; independent Python15s child watchdog covers blocked main thread and kills only captured probe process. Result is recorded before cleanup; cleanup callbacks cannot convert failure to pass. Explicit source/compile/run invocation proposals and acceptance interpretation are in README. Clear limits: no SwiftUI/AX/nested chooser/workspace/file-write/full product or heap-deallocation proof; reference retirement is only probe-held state, and exit is not native proof. A must independently compile/review and run after its current lane; preserve failures. Source93244f8f still unaccepted pending independent review and real gates.
